name: loft
description: Teaches a coding agent to write, change and review a Loft specification in spec/ with the loft command line, and keeps each branch's Yard Log of how its work was planned, asked about, decided and done.

baseBranch.title: Base branch
baseBranch.description: The base branch Yard Log records where git names no other branch the current one was cut from.

loftCommand.title: loft command
loftCommand.description: The command that runs loft, such as `loft`, `npx --no-install loft` or `pnpm exec loft`.

yardPort.title: Yard page port
yardPort.description: The port that the Yard page server listens on, shared by every session on the machine.

yardListen.title: Yard page addresses
yardListen.description: The IP addresses of this machine that the Yard page server listens on beside 127.0.0.1, separated by commas, such as your tailnet address to open the page on your phone, or 0.0.0.0 for every network. Anyone who reaches an address named here can read the page and answer for you. Empty, a page server started from this session opens on this machine alone, and a page server that another session opened wider stays as it is until you run loft yard serve. A new value that names addresses takes effect when the next session starts.
